purpose: Convert every currently open TOKEN_VAZIO into a non-empty, auditable mechanism contract without falsely resolving external, physical, human, governance or scientific dependencies.
invariants: no token may be closed by prose alone
every open token must have urgency, attention state, mechanism, deliverable, verification, falsifier, close_when and claim boundary
external and physical dependencies remain open until their own authority is observed
negative evidence is retained and may close uncertainty without promoting a positive claim

mechanism.trigger: Build one frozen LCDM/CPL/RLL joint likelihood only after every included component has an immutable receipt, covariance/overlap policy, prior lock and executable reference reproduction.
mechanism.verification: Independent per-component loglike reproduction, prior manifest hash, sampler/version/seed receipt, convergence/evidence uncertainty and overlap matrix.
mechanism.falsifier: Any double-counted dataset, unresolved cross-covariance, prior mismatch, missing component receipt, or unstable logZ keeps the token open.

close_when: all included component gates are RESOLVED or explicitly excluded with rationale
joint covariance/overlap contract is frozen
LCDM/CPL/RLL use identical data support and declared priors
nested evidence uncertainty and convergence criteria pass
tokens.claim_boundary: Joint evidence may compare declared models under the frozen data/prior contract; it does not establish a universal cosmological theory.

mechanism.trigger: Freeze a release candidate, inputs, environment manifest, commands and checksums; provide them to an operator who did not author the result path.
mechanism.deliverable: external replication receipt with environment, commands, hashes, outputs, deviations and signed/identifiable provenance
mechanism.verification: Recompute at least the predeclared primary metrics from clean checkout without reusing generated outputs.
mechanism.falsifier: Same-author rerun, copied artifacts, undocumented manual intervention, environment drift or material metric disagreement keeps the token open.

close_when: replicator is independent of the producing execution
clean-checkout reproduction is documented
input/output hashes and environment are frozen
primary metrics agree within predeclared tolerances or disagreement is preserved as negative evidence
tokens.claim_boundary: Internal reruns and CI are reproducibility evidence, not independent replication.

mechanism.driver: official DESI DR2 joint/cross-block likelihood products
mechanism.trigger: Materialize immutable official products and license/provenance metadata, then reproduce official LCDM/CPL reference values before evaluating RLL.
mechanism.verification: Source hash, release/version identifier, covariance shape/order, observable mapping, official reference reproduction and local numerical tolerance receipt.
mechanism.falsifier: Local 13-point/block-diagonal substitutes, missing cross-block covariance, unverifiable provenance or failed official reference reproduction keep the token open.

close_when: official joint/cross-block products are available and materialized
covariance ordering and observable mapping are verified
official LCDM/CPL reference reproduction passes
license/provenance allows the executed use
tokens.claim_boundary: Existing local DESI comparisons are not relabeled as the official joint likelihood.

mechanism.trigger: Run the frozen repository command set on the target no-root device and capture uname/pkg/toolchain, git SHA, stdout/stderr, exit codes, hashes and timing.
mechanism.deliverable: physical-device execution receipt bound to device/runtime metadata and repository SHA
mechanism.verification: Receipt must prove physical Android/Termux authority; container, emulator-only or copied logs are rejected.
mechanism.falsifier: No physical-device metadata, dirty/unidentified checkout, missing command transcript, mismatched hashes or nonzero required exit code keeps the token open.

close_when: physical device authority is recorded
repository SHA and environment are frozen
required commands complete under declared no-root constraints
outputs and checksums are persisted
tokens.claim_boundary: CI/container success cannot substitute for a physical Termux execution claim.

mechanism.trigger: Reuse the verified pinned ACT DR6 materialization/runtime to run a frozen LCDM posterior with explicit priors, sampler, versions, seeds and convergence diagnostics.
mechanism.verification: Chain diagnostics, posterior summary, reference parameter comparison, exact config hash and upstream likelihood/runtime hashes.
mechanism.falsifier: Nonconverged chains, unstated priors, runtime drift, missing chain custody or reference mismatch beyond declared tolerance keeps the token open.

close_when: pinned likelihood/runtime hashes match the verified materialization
posterior chain converges under predeclared diagnostics
priors/config/sampler/seed policy are immutable
reference posterior summary is reproduced within declared tolerances
tokens.claim_boundary: LCDM posterior reproduction validates the ACT execution path, not an RLL CMB prediction.

mechanism.trigger: Materialize the official release with provenance/license, reproduce its declared reference cosmology and freeze nuisance/covariance conventions.
mechanism.verification: Data-vector order, covariance, nuisance priors, scale cuts, reference loglike/posterior and software version hashes.
mechanism.falsifier: Approximate/mock data, missing covariance/nuisance policy, unsupported scale cuts or failed reference reproduction keeps the token open.

close_when: official products are available and immutable
reference likelihood/posterior reproduction passes
nuisance priors and scale cuts are frozen
provenance/license are recorded
tokens.claim_boundary: No RLL LSS claim is allowed from placeholder or nonofficial Y6 inputs.

mechanism.trigger: Version an explicit covariant or explicitly phenomenological closure covering delta_s, theta_s, rest-frame sound speed, entropy/nonadiabatic pressure, anisotropic stress, Q_mu, gauge/initial conditions and transition regularization.
mechanism.verification: Dimensional consistency, background limit, conservation equations, gauge declaration, stability/causality checks where applicable, smooth transition behavior and recovery of declared limiting models.
mechanism.falsifier: Undefined degree of freedom, singular crossing, gauge ambiguity, broken conservation, dimension mismatch or unstable/ill-posed evolution keeps the token open.

close_when: every required perturbation degree of freedom has an explicit rule
initial/gauge conditions and transitions are specified
analytic limiting tests pass
the closure is reviewable without inferring missing physics
tokens.claim_boundary: A closure contract is a model assumption subject to falsification; it is not empirical validation.

mechanism.driver: CLASS and CAMB independent RLL code paths
mechanism.trigger: After M07 is versioned, implement the same closure independently in CLASS and CAMB without sharing generated numerical outputs.
mechanism.deliverable: dual-engine receipt for CMB Cl, transfer functions, growth and linear P(k) with parameter/config hashes
mechanism.verification: Identical cosmological vectors, declared solver precision, convergence with lmax/k grids and predeclared cross-engine tolerances.
mechanism.falsifier: Shared hidden implementation, unresolved closure, cutoff artifact, gauge mismatch or tolerance failure keeps the token open.

close_when: M07 closure is frozen and tests pass
CLASS RLL path executes
CAMB RLL path executes independently
cross-engine observables agree within predeclared tolerances or discrepancy is preserved as negative evidence
tokens.claim_boundary: Dual-engine agreement is numerical implementation evidence, not observational confirmation.

mechanism.driver: primary published H0 prior/likelihood sources used by the 6x4 matrix
mechanism.trigger: Freeze bibliographic authority, exact numerical prior/likelihood definition, version/date, units, covariance if applicable and mapping into repository cells.
mechanism.verification: Each used H0 prior traces to a primary source and exact repository parameterization; secondary summaries alone are insufficient.
mechanism.falsifier: Untraceable number, ambiguous Gaussianization, missing covariance/units, or mismatch between source and executed prior keeps the token open.

close_when: every executed H0 prior has primary-source custody
numeric mapping and units are exact
transformations/approximations are disclosed
source identifiers and retrieval/version dates are frozen
tokens.claim_boundary: A declared prior is not an independently executed H0 likelihood unless its likelihood/data contract is actually reproduced.

mechanism.trigger: Replace or selectable-route the lightweight r_d approximation with validated CLASS/CAMB-backed direct evaluation or a prevalidated interpolation cache in the formal 6x4 inference.
mechanism.verification: Direct-solver/cache agreement, interpolation error bound, compute policy, identical 24-cell optimizer gates, convergence and delta-to-approximation report.
mechanism.falsifier: Unbounded interpolation error, silent fallback to approximation, changed optimization fairness, nonconvergence or engine disagreement keeps the token open.

close_when: full-Boltzmann route is wired into the formal inference
direct/cache error is bounded and recorded
all 24 cells rerun under identical gates
results explicitly compare against the former approximation
tokens.claim_boundary: Integrating full-Boltzmann r_drag removes one numerical approximation; it does not validate RLL perturbations.

mechanism.trigger: Read and record actual repository branch protection/rulesets, required checks, merge policy and Actions permissions from GitHub platform state.
mechanism.deliverable: platform settings receipt with repository, branch/ruleset identifiers, required checks and observation timestamp
mechanism.verification: Observed platform API/settings must match repository-local policy; local YAML alone cannot close this token.
mechanism.falsifier: Unverified settings, missing required check, bypass-capable rule, permissive write token or mismatch with documented topology keeps the token open.

close_when: branch/ruleset state is directly observed
required checks include maturity/governance gates as intended
merge/bypass policy is recorded
Actions permissions are bounded and observed
tokens.claim_boundary: Repository files describe intended policy; only platform-state observation proves external enforcement.

mechanism.trigger: Review the frozen unique-patch cohort after patch-equivalence, classify technical applicability and preserve evidence for every decision.
mechanism.verification: Every unique ref receives one of UNIQUE_APPLICABLE, SUPERSEDED_SEMANTICALLY, OBSOLETE, NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE_ONLY or NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW with evidence paths.
mechanism.falsifier: Anonymous remainder, decision without inspected diff/lineage, automatic forward-port based only on ahead count, or dropped ref keeps the token open.

close_when: all 32 unique-patch refs receive a semantic decision
applicable patches are separately tested before forward-port
superseded/obsolete decisions cite evidence
zero anonymous/unclassified remainder remains
tokens.claim_boundary: Git topology and patch uniqueness do not prove scientific or technical value.

mechanism.trigger: Execute the existing UTM185 void-mask test contract on the target physical Termux environment and bind the receipt to repository SHA and device/runtime metadata.
mechanism.verification: Same 7 local software assertions plus physical Termux authority, command transcript and output hashes.
mechanism.falsifier: Container-only pass, missing physical metadata, different test contract or failed assertion keeps the token open.

close_when: physical Termux execution is recorded
the frozen UTM185 tests pass
repository/environment hashes are preserved
receipt distinguishes software correctness from model-training claims
tokens.claim_boundary: Void-mask unit tests do not prove training stability, task quality or superiority.

mechanism.driver: UTM185 explicit void-mask implementation plus a real tokenizer/model training harness
mechanism.trigger: After physical replay, train matched baseline vs UTM185-mask runs with fixed dataset split, seed policy, optimizer, budget and evaluation metrics.
mechanism.deliverable: UTM185 training ablation receipt with configs, seeds, curves, task metrics, resource use and statistical comparison
mechanism.verification: Multiple seeds or justified deterministic protocol, matched compute budget, held-out evaluation and uncertainty/effect-size reporting.
mechanism.falsifier: Single cherry-picked run, unmatched compute/data, train-set-only metric, missing seeds/configs or no improvement under predeclared metric keeps superiority claims closed.

close_when: real tokenizer/model path is integrated
matched baseline and UTM185 runs complete
evaluation protocol and uncertainty are frozen
results are preserved whether positive, null or negative
tokens.claim_boundary: Training evidence may characterize the implementation; superiority requires the predeclared ablation to support it.
